about: Who the gate's people are and what they do: every painted figure of the scroll map (map/text/S5.md), at its painted spot, and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). figures: played at their spots; do = [clip, seconds] steps cycled with cross-fades; nudge = [dX, dD] metres where our model needs it (reasons in nudge_why); scale for figures painted as children. walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying a load, walking a short way along their painted direction and back (path [X, D] from their spot, clipped to the walkable area, the bridge deck and clear of buildings). animals: each painted animal at its map position (model from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json, load = its painted tack, a cycle of clips); riders are figures with ride = their animal's slug. The carts are not built yet (build_choices.json unbuilt). load_test_traffic: the old invented road traffic, kept only for the load-test panel's extra walkers. Clips are the characters' clips in web/public/assets/chars/characters.json.

clips_why: 2026-10-10 audit (gen/characters/audit_walks/): nobody walks with 'carry' (carter: Carry Heavy Object Walk = both arms held straight out, a zombie without the box; porter: Carry Water Bucket Walk = bends double to the ground) or the sightseer's 'stroll' (Thoughtful Walk = head hanging, arms limp); 'gape' (Look Around Dumbfounded) is out of every cycle. 'idle' is Meshy Idle 3 (243), a calm stand, on every character (the old idle 0 turned round and flung an arm behind). Carrying comes back with props (shoulder pole, baskets).

load_test_traffic.path_why: the mapped road (layout.json route, S5.road.main) from the street inside the city, through the passage and over the bridge; walkers route round anyone standing on it
load_test_traffic.about: invented road traffic, used only by the load-test panel (extra walkers); never shown by default

animals_why.models: species as painted (map/text/S5.md): 8 donkeys, 3 Bactrian camels; the dark rooting animal at the passage mouth, the small animal and the lying form on the open ground are the workshop's pig (the small one a piglet, scale 0.55)
animals_why.loads: as painted: saddle cloths under the three riders, the trace donkey's collar, the pack donkey's pack saddle, the camels' pack frames (camel_6335's with the fan of straw, as the workshop read it)
animals_why.standing: every animal stands at its painted spot with an idle cycle, the head-down ones grazing; the ones painted walking with a rider or a leader stay with them (walking paths for animals come later)
animals_why.nudges: black_animal_7495 moves 1.5 m west and 0.25 m south, against the passage's south jamb: at its painted spot it closed the 1.3 m gap the painted idlers leave at the passage mouth, the only way through the gate (walks.json); camel_lead_7492 moves 0.31 m south: at its painted spot its north flank stood 0.3 m inside the passage's north jamb
